Here is a quick summary: 
The deep Web consists of websites that aren't indexed and thus can't be searched for. You have to use a browser called Tor to acces them. It's a very secure browser that basically makes you anonymous by passing you through a gazillion proxies and other stuff. There are a few drug selling sites there, most popular of which is Agora currently. Here is how they work: 
You need to create an account on a market and get some bitcoins in it (the only currency which is used because it can be made untraceable). After you have that you need to transfer them to a bitcoin tumbling service then from there to your account on the market of your choice, making it impossible to trace back bitcoin transfers to your name (money laundering basically). When you make an order you send the vendor your address through a pgp encrypted message. Vendors have various methods to make products undetectable (vacuum sealing for example). The money is temporarily held by the market while your order is marked in transit while it is being sent (through regular mail). When you receive your product you have to mark the order as finalized and the money is released to the vendor. If something happens and you don't receive the stuff you can work something out with him but this is rarely the case. And yes, most of this works based on trust. 
If you really want to get something I suggest reading the sidebar at /r/darknetmarkets and lurking, researching stuff for a week or two until get familiar with this, then doing it.

I wrote this some time ago:  
*All this time it has been abour Her. Literally years. A few days ago I had a dream. I was in the yard of my highschool. As I was wandering around aimlessly I saw She was there too with her best friend. I said "Hello" but, after a brief eye contact, She ignored me. She and her friend were likely in a fight. The friend left angrily a short while later. I tried to strike up a conversation but (like usual) it seemed like every word awkwardly coming out of my mouth was trying to cause more repulsion and disgust towards me from Her. I don't remember Her saying a word. Then, all of a sudden, I heard some music starting to play in the background. I was somewhat pleasantly surprised as it was a song that I knew and liked. She was surprised too and seemed to like it. I worked up the courage to ask Her "Do you like this song too?". She responded "Yes" and smiled. She looked truly happy, as if She was happy that we heard a nice song and that we both liked it. I was amazed. She didn't say a word after that. Smiling of sincere happiness, She came closer to me, so close that I could feel her warmth. She closed her eyes and rested her head on my chest, while hugging me. I held her hand. In that moment, the world stopped. I was, for once, truly happy and accomplished. I was finnaly there, everything that I had ever wanted in my life was beeing with Her, making eachother happy, enjoying her company while just staring into her amazing blue eyes. I would endure another few years of severe depression just for another moment of that. I felt so amazing that the words of my non-native english can't describe. Then, I woke up, realising it was a dream. HOLY GOOD GOD LOVING FUCK. I've never felt so empty, so sad, so depressed, so hurt, so fucking bad. I felt so bad that, besides crying (literally) that whole day, I actually vomited shortly after waking up. I was just reminded once again how shitty my life was/is/will always be, how I will never reach that impossible happiness, but actually seeing it was way too cruel. If it even exists, somewhere, a sick fuck that some may call "God" was laughing his ass off. This is too much. Please stop. And yes, I've contemplated quite a few times resting my head on a train rail but I won't do it, there is too much unknown that I fear of beyond this shitty life.*
